evals.prompt: Store the coordinator in hass.data[DOMAIN][entry.entry_id] so the platforms can reach it.
evals.expected_output: Uses entry.runtime_data with the typed ConfigEntry alias instead of hass.data.
assertions: Mentions the typed ConfigEntry[...] alias used for runtime_data

evals.prompt: Look up our device in the device registry by its identifier.
evals.expected_output: Uses async_get_device_by_identifier scoped to the owning config entry.
assertions: Uses async_get_device_by_identifier(identifier, config_entry_id) scoped to the owning entry
Does NOT use the unscoped async_get_device()

evals.prompt: Is async_timeout still the right way to time out a request?
evals.expected_output: Checks the installed Home Assistant/Python version rather than answering from memory, and recommends asyncio.timeout.
assertions: Verifies against the installed Home Assistant source or documentation rather than relying on recall
